name: Mondelez Fort Worth Distribution Center - Fort Worth TX

fieldNotes.locate: Resolved to 16200 Three Wide Dr, Fort Worth TX 76177 (IDI/Speedway Distribution Center Building C), in the AllianceTexas industrial corridor near Texas Motor Speedway. Google geocode returned a ROOFTOP hit at 33.0315793,-97.3007312 (returned with the 76247 Northlake ZIP, but the building is the one a confirmed-address probe pinned). Satellite confirms a large completed Class-A cross-dock distribution building consistent with the listed 316,128 SF Building C. The old stub mislabeled this site 'Garland TX' — corrected to Fort Worth.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Cross-dock building: dock banks on BOTH the north and the south building faces. The north face carries the bulk of the trailer activity plus the drop yard; the south face has a second dock bank fronting the office/car-parking side. Counted as separate ship/receive clusters.
fieldNotes.truckGate: The truck court is fully enclosed by chain-link fencing. Street View (Dec 2024) at the SE truck-court entrance shows a sliding chain-link gate across the truck driveway where it enters the fenced truck court between Building C and the adjacent building. truckGate = true.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth observed beside the truck-court gate in Street View — a sliding chain-link gate only. remoteGs (kiosk / app / call-box check-in) inferred. Flagged uncertain: a small booth could be obscured by trailers in the available panos.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: The truck court and gate apron are very wide with substantial unused paved width and deep stacking depth — physical room to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: Estimated ~115 doors total across the long north dock bank and the south dock bank of this ~316k SF cross-dock building. Honest overhead estimate — flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.drop: Large drop yard along the north side with rows of parked trailers (no tractors); dropArea 50+.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: AllianceTexas is an edge-of-metro master-planned logistics park surrounded by open land, the speedway, and FM-156 — graded Rural per the rubric tie-breaker (large speculative-industrial park, not dense metro fabric).
fieldNotes.geofences: Perimeter captures the building plus the north truck/drop yard and south car-parking apron: ~367 m N-S x ~588 m E-W = ~53 acres. truckGate box is the SE fenced-court entrance.
